For months, reliable leaks suggested that Apple was preparing to launch new Apple TV 4K models and updated HomePod minis before the end of 2025. But now that we’re at the end of December, it’s clear that Apple isn’t releasing any new home hardware this year.

Reports suggest Apple is sticking with the same familiar Apple TV design, but under the hood, the upgrades could be significant. Rumors point to Apple’s new N1 wireless chip with Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread support, along with a major performance jump from the A15 Bionic to a potential A17 Pro chip.
If that happens, the next Apple TV could support faster streaming, lower latency gaming, and possibly even Apple Intelligence features tied to the next generation of Siri on tvOS. However, recent leaks suggest Apple may rely on MediaTek wireless chips instead of its own N1 for lower-cost devices like HomePod mini.
